Depending on your carrier's requirements, you may need to contact your carrier or visit their store to recover your deleted eSIM.
profile_notifications_help:
eSIM profiles can send notifications to the carrier when they are downloaded, deleted, enabled, or disabled. The queue of these notifications to be sent is listed here.

In Settings, you can specify whether to send each type of notification automatically. Note that even if a notification has been sent, it will not be deleted automatically from the record, unless the queue runs out of space.

Here, you can manually send or delete each pending notification.
